acceptanceCriteria: Measured per-write cost on the 880-ticket intent tree before and after, with load band recorded.
SNAPSHOT_MOVED and stale-cache counterexamples (touch without change, change within mtime granularity) are tested and refused or re-read.
body:
Observed: the 880-ticket intent tree is re-read to compute intent.TreeDigest on each write, and the receipt directory is re-listed. Related: V1-0646 (shares one observation inside a single read), V1-0645. Request: a stat-keyed cache (path, size, mtime, inode) across calls so unchanged files are not re-read, without weakening the SNAPSHOT_MOVED movement check.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).

holds.reason: Owner decision: decision 0549 F1 declined the stat cache; building it reverses that decision.

title: Stat-keyed cache for intent TreeDigest and the receipt listing
